Select drug-indication relationships with molecule ChEMBL identifiers, preferred names, MeSH identifiers, MeSH headings, indication CURIEs, indication labels, and maximum phase for indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication. Alias mesh_id as indication_curie and mesh_heading as indication_label. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
